acceptance_gate: A and B prove their claims with checks that replay each construction on the census laws and on affine laws with tops of size four, and reject every control.
objective: Serves open question 3 of docs/KNOT_INTUITION.md (composition) after THOMSEN-KNOTS-20261021-001, which proved that no circuit of a law composing like cycles overlaps, so that composing like cycles is exactly having Latin circuits modulo the tops, and left open Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001: a ternary polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the tops of knot ranges. The owner approved a fresh epic on Mal'tsev structure on the tops (three-variable circuits as abelian p-groups, gluing across a range, larger circuits, and whether every top image is closed under the operation). Scoping found a shorter route: Latin circuits make every fibre of a top image the same size, so every top image is rectangular, and the classical rectangularity argument then yields a polymorphism that is Mal'tsev modulo the top of the range generated by its arguments. On 1,650 sampled systems of eleven census laws every top image had uniform fibres and was rectangular; such polymorphisms exist in parity beside J and K4 beside Z3, where the all-ranges form fails; and the parallelogram operations of knots were affine over elementary abelian p-groups. A proves rectangularity, Conjecture 7 and a characterization of composing like cycles; B proves that the tops of knot ranges are affine over elementary abelian p-groups, that three-variable circuits are such groups modulo the tops, and that every system's matroid is a direct sum of matroids representable over finite fields.
status: Complete 2026-10-21. In a law that composes like cycles every top image has uniform fibres and is rectangular, so a ternary polymorphism is Mal'tsev modulo the top of the range generated by its arguments and, by a lemma on subranges of knot ranges, modulo the top of every knot range: Conjecture 7 of CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 holds. A law composes like cycles exactly when ranges have tops, ties are bijections modulo the tops, and some ternary polymorphism is Mal'tsev modulo the tops of the knot ranges. Each knot range's top is an elementary abelian p-group on which that operation is x - y + z, polymorphisms act affinely, top images on knot-range variables are cosets, and three-variable circuits are addition tables. Every system's matroid is a direct sum of parallel classes and matroids representable over finite fields, and all such sums occur: the weak form of Conjecture 5 of MATROID-CONVERSE-20261021-001B-P001. Next (owner's decision): result conversion after a literature check (2/3).
stop_rule: Stop after B. Stop earlier if a law composing like cycles in every checked system is found whose top image is not rectangular, or that has no polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo its generated tops; that law would refute the argument and become the subject.
title: Mal'tsev structure on the tops
